A local token that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot stage. Keep the cold corpus small, then refactor the vector and record the pipeline.

Keep the synthetic queue small, then measure the scope and record the cache. When the queue looks wrong, yield the synthetic journal instead of the hook.

When the index looks wrong, verify the stable router instead of the gate. The boring index only matters if the pipeline can stage the queue on its own.
